{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit top: fitted crew-neck pullover, hip length, cream (#efe6d6), thin merino wool.

Maxi skirt: A-line with soft pleats, floor-grazing ankle length, deep bottle green (#2f4a3f), matte crepe with a gentle drape.

Textured jacket: slightly tailored single-breasted blazer, hip length, warm camel (#b58f66), wool bouclé.

Ankle boots: pointed toe, 5 cm block heel, dark chocolate (#4a3428), smooth leather.

Clutch: small structured envelope shape, antique gold (#b08d57), soft grained leather.

Earrings: small drop earrings, warm gold (#c9a45c), polished metal.

This outfit gives you the long maxi skirt you asked for, and the 5 cm block heel on the boots is comfortable for a whole evening in the theatre. The cream knit, bottle-green skirt and bouclé jacket are neat and polished without being overdressed. The deep green picks up the grey-green of your eyes, while the camel and cream bring out the warmth of your golden hair and skin under artificial light. The jacket keeps you warm on an autumn evening and comes off easily in the auditorium."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2538,"output_tokens":868},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
